exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb TE + sashiageru".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
動詞て形 + さしあげる
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞て形 + さしあげる matches "Verb TE + sashiageru".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞て形 + さしあげる.
exercises.explanation: Do something for someone of higher status in a humble, respectful way.
